meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: Claude 会把一个持久化的 wiki 知识库加到 NanoClaw 群:创建 wiki/ 和 sources/ 目录,写 index.md 与 log.md,并生成容器技能和群级 CLAUDE.md 说明,让 Claude 负责资料录入、查询和检查。
howto.when: 当你说“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”等触发词,或要求给 NanoClaw 群添加知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群加一个 wiki 知识库。
say.note: 它会先读 LLM Wiki 模式并和你讨论设计。

say.text: 我想收录 PDF 和网页链接,建个知识库。
say.note: 它会确认资料类型并检查所需技能。

say.text: 把 sources 里的文件逐个读并写进 wiki。
say.note: 它会按规则逐个处理并更新索引。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/, writes index.md and log.md, and adds a container skill and a group CLAUDE.md section so the agent can ingest, query, and lint the wiki.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", or similar trigger words, or ask to add a knowledge base to a NanoClaw group.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group.
say_en.note: It reads the LLM Wiki pattern and discusses design with you.

say_en.text: I want a knowledge base for PDFs and web links.
say_en.note: It checks source types and needed skills.

say_en.text: Read files in sources one by one and write them into the wiki.
say_en.note: It finishes each file before moving on.
